intro: Ivory Coast is a presidential republic, led by a powerful elected president.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years and appoints the prime minister and government. Parliament has a National Assembly and a Senate. Alassane Ouattara won a fourth term in 2025.

chapters.title: Regional role
text: Ivory Coast is a leading member of the West African bloc ECOWAS and uses the West African CFA franc.
